title: Outage events
description: Outage events with customers affected and reliability minutes.

title: Customers affected
description: Number of customers without supply during the outage.

title: SAIDI minutes
description: Contribution of the outage to the System Average Interruption Duration Index (customer-minutes / customers served).

title: Tariffs
description: Tariff schedules with energy and demand rates.

title: Rate per kWh
description: Energy price per kWh under the tariff. A rate: average, never sum.
